description: This file defines the LeadsViewDetail class, which extends ViewDetail and manages the display logic for lead detail views in the SuiteCRM application. It includes functionality to show a PDF letter popup and conditionally disables the convert lead action based on the lead's status and configuration.

classes.name: LeadsViewDetail
classes.description: A view class responsible for displaying lead details and associated UI elements in SuiteCRM.

methods.name: display
methods.description: Overridden method that renders the lead detail view, includes a PDF letter popup, and disables the convert lead action if the lead is already converted and the feature is disabled in configuration.
